name: Churnkey
summary: Churnkey's Payment Recovery feature runs smart retries, dunning campaigns and in-app card updates after a failed payment. Its pricing page lists Starter at $250 a month billed yearly or $300 billed monthly, and Core from $500 a month billed yearly. Intelligence starts at $625 a month billed yearly, and Enterprise is quoted.

evidence.capability: smart retries after a failed payment
customer emails and SMS about failed payments

facts.text: Churnkey's home page says Payment Recovery gets customers paid with smart retries, dunning campaigns and in-app card updates.
Its home page says Payment Recovery can recover failed payments without customer intervention, and that it reaches customers by SMS, email or in the app when hard declines happen.
The pricing page's plan table lists Payment Recovery, unlimited dunning campaigns and self-improving retry logic. Core and Intelligence add A/B testing of Payment Recovery.
Its pricing page says Intelligence is tailored by Churnkey's Retention Specialists, and Enterprise is a custom quote.

plans.name: Starter
plans.unit: per month, for teams under $5k monthly churn
plans.notes: Listed as $250 a month billed yearly, or $300 a month billed monthly.

plans.name: Core
plans.unit: per month, up to $10k monthly churn volume
plans.notes: Listed as from $500 a month billed yearly. Monthly billing starts at $600 a month for up to $10k churn volume. Higher churn tiers are priced by the page's stated ranges, with gaps shown.

plans.name: Intelligence
plans.unit: per month, billed yearly, tailored by Churnkey
plans.notes: Listed as from $625 a month billed yearly. Quarterly billing starts at $750 a month for up to $10k churn volume. No monthly option.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: No price shown. The page says to contact the Churnkey team for a custom Enterprise quote.

hiddenCosts: The pricing page uses dollar signs and does not name a currency.
The page does not price dunning separately. It appears only as a feature inside each plan.
The page shows no price for churn volume between $50k and $60k, between $60k and $90k, or above $100k.
